note: What a client sends once it has taken in a group of movements, naming which group and listing the units the group asked it to relocate.

fields.name: syncId
fields.note: Which group is being acknowledged, as the group named itself.

fields.name: relocationCount
fields.note: How many relocations follow. It counts every movement in the group that carried a token, whether or not the token moved anything.

fields.name: unit
fields.note: The unit the token belonged to.

fields.name: token
fields.note: The token that arrived with it.
